memberships.page_title: Can the Symmetric Descendant Be Made Smaller and Keller?
Bounds and Obstructions for Symmetric Dilations

statement: If an n-dimensional homogeneous map has a k-dimensional partial-gradient block, it admits a weak symmetric dilation in dimension at most 2n-k; in particular every polynomial map has weak symmetric-dilation dimension at most 2n-1.
